title: Sweet Shop Picture Walk
hook: Name the treat and let it go!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: friendly 3D sweet-shop storybook, pastel bakery cases without readable labels, neat isolated treats, warm light

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: storybook bakery visitor using pretend motions only
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: two-line memory anchor whose orchestration changes on repeat
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: Round 1 notices shape, layers, crust, swirl, crumb or topping; keep it descriptive and musical rather than advertising sweetness.
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: Round 2 uses a clean recall gap and item-specific visual gestures: pies/tarts trace crust and filling; cupcakes show wrapper and top; donuts make ring/fill shapes; eclairs go oblong; macarons show two shells plus filling; layered pastries stack fingers; breads show loaf, score, roll, cross, raisins, nuts, or wholegrain flecks; pretzels knot; waffles grid; roll cakes spiral; toppings spread, drip, or sprinkle in the air. Ice Cream stays a frozen scoop clue. No real baking operations are instructed.
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a quiet acoustic shelf-pluck plus marimba confirmation.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a quiet acoustic shelf-pluck plus marimba confirmation
